strategy_sweep.note: Sweep compares rule-signal, score-return allocation variants, and the fixed-threshold rule; it is diagnostics, not prediction training.

risk_controls.rule: If portfolio drawdown reaches warning line, cap non-QQQ tilt at 5%; if it reaches de-risk line, keep at least 30% in SGOV; if it reaches stop line, pause new GLD/QQQ tilts and direct new contribution to SGOV until next monthly review.
risk_controls.interpretation: Oracle headroom shows the asset-rotation opportunity is large, but current AUC is too weak; risk lines should stay close to the QQQ DCA drawdown until prediction AUC improves.

breadth_200dma.description: Share of the tradable ETF universe above its own 200-day moving average, decimal 0-1.
breadth_200dma.source_note: Computed from local QQQ/GLD/SGOV daily price history available at the monthly decision date.

tbill_3m_rate.description: 3-month Treasury bill secondary market discount rate as a decimal.
tbill_3m_rate.source_note: Pulled from FRED DTB3 and converted from percent to decimal.

factor_validation.point_in_time_rule: Each row must contain only data observable before that month's strategy decision date. Label columns may use future data and must be used only for evaluation, never as input features.

leakage_audit.rule: A training observation is allowed only when its forward-label end index is strictly less than the current prediction index.

prediction_module.diagnosis: Main rule-signal prediction AUC is still below target; the sklearn linear model is kept as a benchmark until its score-to-allocation mapping is validated.

strategy_module.diagnosis: Strategy should remain conservative until prediction AUC improves.

backtest_module.diagnosis: Backtest is leakage-checked and reports oracle/worst-case scenarios.

leakage_control.label: Each label uses a future 30-calendar-day window mapped to actual trading days, and is used only for training later months.
leakage_control.walk_forward: For each date and asset, the model trains only on earlier observations for that asset.
leakage_control.strategy: Strategy consumes only current-month predicted scores and expected returns.

logic.module_1_prediction: Prediction module supports pluggable estimators: rule_signal is the main estimator, model_walk_forward is retained as a model benchmark.
logic.module_2_strategy: Main strategy uses legacy QQQ score thresholds; model score-return allocation is reported as a scenario, not the default strategy.
logic.module_3_backtest: Reports compare strategy vs QQQ DCA plus oracle and worst-case scenarios.
